name: Ekta — 14th floor, Neeldhara
subtitle: designed on the builder's DWG · 1073 sq ft RERA · 8 rooms

titleBlock.scaleNote: Designed on the builder’s DWG. The import read his drawing — wall centrelines paired from his drawn faces, doors off his door layer, envelope from the RERA carpet boundary, every room checked against his own dimension text — and that record is frozen as design.imported.py. What is drawn here is what replaces it: his thirteen rooms rebuilt as eight, every internal wall new, and the flat furnished throughout.
